title: Bounded acyclic reduced cone with class terms
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring, $I$ an ideal, and $\mathcal P$ a class of $R$-modules closed under binary sums in the precise sense that $P_1\in\mathcal P$ and $P_{12}\in\mathcal P$ if and only if $P_1,P_2\in\mathcal P$ whenever $P_{12}\cong P_1\times P_2$. Let $K$ be a bounded-above complex with terms in $\mathcal P$, and $E$ a bounded-above $R/I$-complex whose terms are isomorphic to reductions of class members. For any quasi-isomorphism $\delta:E\to (R/I)\otimes_R K$, its actual mapping cone is bounded above, acyclic, and each cone term is isomorphic to the reduction of a class member.

source.place: Stacks Project, Tag 0BCA, cone construction paragraph

proof.text: Use the maximum of the two bounds; the cone term at i is the biproduct of E at i+1 and reduced K at i, hence vanishes above this bound.
The distinguished cone triangle and the identification of quasi-isomorphisms with morphisms having acyclic cone prove acyclicity (Mathlib HomotopyCategory.quasiIso_eq_trW_subcategoryAcyclic).

Choose P reducing to E at i+1. The closure equivalence puts the actual biproduct P plus K at i in the class. Extension of scalars preserves binary coproducts and zero morphisms, hence binary biproducts. Compose the mapBiprod isomorphism with eP and homotopyCofiber.XIsoBiprod to identify its reduction with the cone term.

lean.statement: theorem complex_lift_cone_properties (R : Type u) [CommRing R] (I : Ideal R) (Pclass : Set (ModuleCat.{max u v} R)) (E : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{max u v} (R ⧸ I)) ℤ) (K : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{max u v} R) ℤ) (hclosed : ∀ P₁ P₂ P₁₂ : ModuleCat.{max u v} R, Nonempty (P₁₂ ≅ ModuleCat.of R (P₁ × P₂)) → (P₁ ∈ Pclass ∧ P₁₂ ∈ Pclass ↔ P₁ ∈ Pclass ∧ P₂ ∈ Pclass)) (hKbound : ∃ b : ℤ, K.IsStrictlyLE b) (hKterms : ∀ i : ℤ, K.X i ∈ Pclass) (hEbound : ∃ b : ℤ, E.IsStrictlyLE b) (hEterms : ∀ i : ℤ, ∃ P : ModuleCat.{max u v} R, P ∈ Pclass ∧ Nonempty (E.X i ≅ (ModuleCat.extendScalars (Ideal.Quotient.mk I)).obj P)) (δ : E ⟶ ((ModuleCat.extendScalars (Ideal.Quotient.mk I)).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj K) [QuasiIso δ] : (∃ b : ℤ, (CochainComplex.mappingCone δ).IsStrictlyLE b) ∧ (CochainComplex.mappingCone δ).Acyclic ∧ ∀ i : ℤ, ∃ P : ModuleCat.{max u v} R, P ∈ Pclass ∧ Nonempty ((ModuleCat.extendScalars (Ideal.Quotient.mk I)).obj P ≅ (CochainComplex.mappingCone δ).X i)
